title: 第725章 这是辣它不会咬舌头第724章 大夏小炒香懵圣城
slug: 魔法我钢铁洪流直接平推
lines: 李雯那边的小烤炉也没停过。
蜂蜜小面包烤得表皮金黄，掰开后热气腾腾，里面松软得像云。
蛋挞外皮酥得掉渣，内馅嫩滑香甜。
几个神圣人族小孩吃完后，眼巴巴站在窗口前，舍不得走。
一个穿着旧长裙的妇人原本只给孩子买了一个蛋挞。
孩子咬了一口，立刻把剩下半个护在手心里，小声问：
“妈妈，这个能不能带回去给爸爸尝尝？”
妇人愣了一下，摸了摸钱袋，又咬牙买了两个。
李雯看见这一幕，悄悄多夹了一个小面包放进去。
妇人连声道谢，脸上笑得有些不好意思。
不远处，黑麦面包小贩看得目瞪口呆。
他摊子前半天没来几个人，旁边这辆大夏餐车，却已经排起长队。
更离谱的是，许多客人一边喊着这菜咬舌头好辣，一边大口继续吃。
吃完小炒肉，又买面包。
吃完面包，又买啤酒可乐。
最后还问能不能打包。
“这是施了什么魔法吗？”面包小贩喃喃自语。
旁边一个老佣兵擦着额头的汗，端着蛋炒粉嗦个不停。
“不是魔法，你自己尝尝。”
他把最后一口饭扒进嘴里，含糊说道：
“是香，太好吃了！”
说完，他举起空碗。
“老板，再来一份，你这虽然会咬舌头，但过瘾好吃！”
王强：“说多少遍了，这是辣，它不会咬舌头！”
队伍又是一阵哄笑。
这时，巡逻士兵终于走了过来。
王强心里一紧，还以为人太多影响秩序，赶紧说道：
“我们马上让队伍靠边排，不堵路。”
翻译扩音刚落，那名士兵摇了摇头。
他板着脸，先扫了一眼队伍，又看向菜单。
“你们没有堵住街道，没关系。”
“另外，那个好香的什么肉炒饭，还有吗？”
排队的人群先是一静，随即哄笑起来。
content_en:
Li Wen’s small oven never stopped.
The honey buns are baked to a golden brown on the outside, steaming hot when broken open, and as soft as clouds inside.
The egg tart is crispy on the outside and tender and sweet on the inside.
After several Holy Human children finished eating, they stood eagerly in front of the window, reluctant to leave.
A woman wearing an old dress originally only bought an egg tart for her child.
The child took a bite, immediately held the remaining half in his hand, and asked in a low voice:
"Mom, can you take this back and give it to dad to try?"
The woman was stunned for a moment, touched her purse, gritted her teeth and bought two more.
Li Wen saw this scene and quietly put in an extra bun.
The woman thanked her profusely and smiled sheepishly.
Not far away, the rye bread vendor looked dumbfounded.
Not many people came to his stall for the first half of the day, but there was already a long queue for the Daxia food truck next to it.
What's even more outrageous is that many customers continued to eat while shouting that this dish was so spicy that they bit their tongues.
After eating the stir-fried pork, I bought some bread.
After eating the bread, I bought beer and coke.
Finally, I asked if I could pack it up.
"Is this some kind of magic?" the bread vendor muttered to himself.
An old mercenary next to him wiped the sweat from his forehead and kept chattering while holding fried egg noodles.
"It's not magic, try it yourself."
He put the last bite of rice into his mouth and said vaguely:
"It's fragrant, so delicious!"
After speaking, he raised the empty bowl.
"Boss, let's have another one. Although you may bite your tongue, it's delicious!"
Wang Qiang: "How many times have I told you, this is spicy, it won't bite your tongue!"
The team burst into laughter again.
At this time, the patrolling soldiers finally came over.
Wang Qiang felt nervous, thinking that too many people would affect order, so he quickly said:
"We immediately moved the team to the side so as not to block the road."
As soon as the translator's loudspeaker ended, the soldier shook his head.
With a straight face, he glanced at the queue and then at the menu.
"You're not blocking the street, that's okay."
"Also, is there any more of that delicious fried rice with meat?"
The crowd in line was silent for a moment, then burst into laughter.
title_en: Chapter 725: It’s so spicy that it won’t bite its tongue Chapter 724: Daxia’s stir-fry is fragrant in the Holy City
